ski: Snow builds in the Washington Cascades Thursday, the snow level falls to the valley floor Friday, and Saturday dries out. hike: Rain and snow move through the Washington Cascades Thursday, and Saturday turns drier. Best hike day: Hurricane Ridge on Friday, good weather window all day, through 10 PM, NWAC has no rating posted.
